```{r}
# Table 1. Summary statistics of outcome, primary exposure and covariates
table1 <- tbl_summary(
  analysis_df,
  include = c(diabetes_status, socioeconomic_status, race, physactiv_cat, sex, age_group),
  type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
  statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})" , "{median} ({p25}-{p75})",
                                   "{min}-{max}")
) |>
add_n() |> # add column with total number of non-missing observations
modify_header(label = "**Variable**") |>
modify_caption("**Person Characteristics**")

table1ft <- as_flex_table(table1)

save_as_image(table1ft, path = here("assets", "table1.png"))

    
```

```{r}
# Table 2. Univariate analysis of diabetes
table2 <- tbl_summary(
  analysis_df,
  include = c(socioeconomic_status, race, physactiv_cat, sex, age_group),
  type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
  statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})" , "{median} ({p25}-{p75})",
                                   "{min}-{max}") ,
  by = diabetes_status, # split table by group
) |>
add_n() |> # add column with total number of non-missing observations
add_p() |> # test for a difference between groups
modify_header(label = "**Variable**") |>
modify_caption("**Person Characteristics by Diabetes**") |>
bold_labels() |>
modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Diabetes Cases**")

table2ft <- as_flex_table(table2)

save_as_image(table2ft, path = here("assets", "table2.png"))

```

```{r}
# Table 3. Economic hardship as a predictor
table3 <- tbl_summary(
  analysis_df,
  include = c(diabetes_status, race, physactiv_cat, sex, age_group),
  type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
  statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})" , "{median} ({p25}-{p75})",
                                   "{min}-{max}") ,
  percent = "row",
  by = socioeconomic_status, # split table by group
) |>
add_n() |> # add column with total number of non-missing observations
add_p() |> # test for a difference between groups
modify_header(label = "**Predictors**") |>
modify_caption("**Predictors of Diabetes**") |>
bold_labels() |>
modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Economic Hardship (1 = Yes)**")

table3ft <- as_flex_table(table3)

save_as_image(table3ft, path = here("assets", "table3.png"))
```

```{r}
# Table 4. 2x2 crosstab of Diabetes and Socioeconomic status
table5 <- analysis_df %>%
  tabyl(socioeconomic_status, diabetes_status) %>%
  adorn_totals(where = c("row", "col")) %>%
  adorn_percentages("col") %>%
  adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 1) %>%
  adorn_ns("front") %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "white") %>%  # header row
  row_spec(1:2, background = "white")  # all body rows

save_kable(
  table5,
  file = here("assets", "table4.png")
)

```

Creating univariate model
```{r}
# Univariate model
Model1 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status, data = analysis_df, 
              family = binomial(link = "logit"))

# Summary of univariate model
summary(Model1)

```

Calculating the odds ratio with CI
```{r}
# Table 4. OR and CI using low economic hardship group as a reference
table5 <- analysis_df %>%
  select(diabetes_status, socioeconomic_status) %>%
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = glm,
    y = diabetes_status,
    method.args = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(socioeconomic_status ~ "Economic Hardship")
  ) %>%
  add_n(location = "level")

table5 <- tbl_stack(list(table5)) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 3. Association Between Economic Status and Type 2 Diabetes**") %>%
  bold_labels()

table5gt <- as_gt(table5)

gtsave(table5gt, here("assets", "table5.png"))

```


Create multivariate model
```{r}
# Multivariate model adjusting for covariates
Model2 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status+race_collapsed+physactiv_cat+age_group, 
              data = analysis_df, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
# Summary of multivariate model
summary(Model2)

```

Finding the most parsimonious model using backward AIC selection
```{r}
# Backward selection using AIC
backwardmod <- step(Model2, direction = "backward")
```


Analysis of covariates with odds ratios and confidence intervals
```{r}
# Table 6. Analysis of covariates
table6a <- analysis_df %>%
  select(diabetes_status, race_collapsed) %>%
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = glm,
    y = diabetes_status,
    method.args = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(race_collapsed ~ "Race")
  ) %>%
  add_n(location = "level")

table6b <- analysis_df %>%
  select(diabetes_status, physactiv_cat) %>%
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = glm,
    y = diabetes_status,
    method.args = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(physactiv_cat ~ "Physical Activity")
  ) %>%
  add_n(location = "level")

table6c <- analysis_df %>%
  select(diabetes_status, age_group) %>%
  tbl_uvregression(
    method = glm,
    y = diabetes_status,
    method.args = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(age_group ~ "Age Group")
  ) %>%
  add_n(location = "level")

table6 <- tbl_stack(list(table6a, table6b, table6c)) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 6. Association Between Covariates and Type 2 Diabetes**") %>%
  bold_labels()

table6gt <- as_gt(table6)

gtsave(table6gt, here("assets", "table6.png"))

```




Sensitivity Analysis
```{r}
# Table 7. Sensitivity Analysis

# Primary analysis
sens_primary <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
                   data = analysis_df,
                   family = binomial)

# Sensitivity 1: Males only
analysis_male <- analysis_df %>% 
  filter(sex == "Male")
sens1 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
            data = analysis_male,
            family = binomial)

# Sensitivity 2: Females only
analysis_female <- analysis_df %>% 
  filter(sex == "Female")
sens2 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
            data = analysis_female,
            family = binomial)

# Sensitivity 3: White children only
analysis_white <- analysis_df %>% 
  filter(race_collapsed == "White, non-Hispanic")
sens3 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
            data = analysis_white,
            family = binomial)

# Sensitivity 4: Non-White children
analysis_nonwhite <- analysis_df %>% 
  filter(race_collapsed != "White, non-Hispanic")
sens4 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
            data = analysis_nonwhite,
            family = binomial)

# Sensitivity 5: Different FPL cutoff qualifying as low ses
analysis_df_fpl <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(socioeconomic_status = factor(
      as.integer(FOODSIT >= 3 | ACE1 >= 3 | FPL_MIN < 200),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("High/Med status", "Lower status")))

sens6 <- glm(diabetes_status ~ socioeconomic_status,
            data = analysis_df_fpl,
            family = binomial)

# Create Table 5 - Sensitivity Analyses (EXPANDED)
sens_results <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c(
    "Primary: All children, dichotomized PA",
    "Sensitivity 1: Males only",
    "Sensitivity 2: Females only",
    "Sensitivity 3: White children only",
    "Sensitivity 4: Non-White children",
    "Sensitivity 5: FPL < 200 qualifies as low SES"
  ),
  N_Cases = c(
    sum(analysis_df$diabetes_status == "Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_male$diabetes_status == "Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_female$diabetes_status == "Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_white$diabetes_status == "Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_nonwhite$diabetes_status == "Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_df_fpl$diabetes_status == "Diabetes")
  ),
  N_Controls = c(
    sum(analysis_df$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_male$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_female$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_white$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_nonwhite$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes"),
    sum(analysis_df_fpl$diabetes_status == "No Diabetes")
  ),
  OR = c(
    round(exp(coef(sens_primary)[2]), 2),
    round(exp(coef(sens1)[2]), 2),
    round(exp(coef(sens2)[2]), 2),
    round(exp(coef(sens3)[2]), 2),
    round(exp(coef(sens4)[2]), 2),
    round(exp(coef(sens6)[2]), 2)
  ),
  CI_lower = c(
    round(exp(confint(sens_primary)[2,1]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens1)[2,1]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens2)[2,1]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens3)[2,1]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens4)[2,1]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens6)[2,1]), 2)
  ),
  CI_upper = c(
    round(exp(confint(sens_primary)[2,2]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens1)[2,2]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens2)[2,2]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens3)[2,2]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens4)[2,2]), 2),
    round(exp(confint(sens6)[2,2]), 2)
  )
)

sens_results$Cases_Total <- paste0(sens_results$N_Cases, "/",
                                   sens_results$N_Cases + sens_results$N_Controls)
sens_results$OR_CI <- paste0(sens_results$OR, " (",
                             sens_results$CI_lower, ", ",
                             sens_results$CI_upper, ")")

table7_display <- sens_results %>%
  select(Analysis, Cases_Total, OR_CI)

# Save as flextable
table7ft <- flextable(table7_display) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Analysis = "Analysis Specification",
    Cases_Total = "N Cases/Total",
    OR_CI = "OR (95% CI)"
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  add_header_lines("Table 7. Sensitivity Analyses")

save_as_image(table7ft, path = here("assets", "table7.png"))

```
